title: Sprite Contract v1.0
description: Structural schema for a root manifest (sprites.contract.yml/json) AND for any included contract file. Cross-file rules (unique ids, unique targets, placeholders) are enforced by `sprite-admin validate`, see docs/CONTRACT.md.

contract.description: Spec version. Always "1.0" for this schema.

project.description: ROOT MANIFEST ONLY (ignored, with a warning, in included files). Names the project and defines where targets live.

description.description: Context for artists/AIs: what the app is, the art style, palette, perspective.

root.description: Directory all target paths are relative to. Relative to the manifest file.

backups.description: Copy files that an upload overwrites to <root>/.sprite-admin/backups/<timestamp>/.

include.description: Other contract files (path or glob, relative to THIS file). Globs support *, ** and ?. Processed in order; glob matches alphabetically.

folders.description: Optional metadata per folder path (folders themselves are derived from sprite ids).

icon.description: A single emoji or short symbol.

spec.description: Requirements an uploaded image must meet. Every key is optional.

multipleOf.description: Both dimensions must be a multiple of this (e.g. 8 for tile grids).

formats.description: Allowed file formats. Default: the formats implied by the target extensions.

alpha.description: required = must have a transparency channel; forbidden = must be opaque.

strict.description: false = violations are warnings and uploads are still accepted.

defaults.description: Values inherited by sprites. Layering: root defaults < file defaults < folder defaults (outer to inner) < the sprite itself. `spec` is merged key by key; everything else is replaced.

targets.description: May use {id}, {name}, {folder} and matrix variables, e.g. assets/{id}.png

id.description: Unique, slash-separated. The part before the last slash is the UI folder. With `matrix`, may contain {variables}.

title.description: Display name. Default: humanized last id segment.

description.description: REQUIRED. What the image must show, concrete enough to draw it without seeing the app.

required.description: false = optional: listed, but not needed for 100% progress.

notes.description: Extra hints: style, animation timing, where it is used.

reference.description: URL or text pointing at a style reference.

matrix.description: Expands this entry into one sprite per combination. Variables: lowercase [a-z][a-z0-9_]*. Use {var} or {var:02} (zero-padded) in id, title, description, notes, tags, reference and target paths.
